plugins.name: Codex Invite

plugins.author: thebtf

zh-CN.description: 当主模型因配额、限流、传输故障或指定 HTTP 状态码失败时，自动按配置的回退模型名称重试匹配的模型请求。

zh-CN.description: 提供 Codex 账号用量、配额追踪、429 自动封禁及提供商成本看板。

plugins.author: DoingDog

zh-CN.description: 使用有序的精确匹配、通配符、大小写转换及基于认证 API Key 作用域的规则，将请求的模型名映射为上游模型，可在不修改客户端配置的情况下切换上游模型、整合别名或按调用方路由至不同模型。

plugins.name: CAP Token Usage Tracker

zh-CN.description: 持久化追踪 Token 用量，支持按小时聚合与多维度统计（模型、提供商、执行器、别名、来源、认证类型、服务层级、推理强度、失败情况），并在管理中心提供内嵌中文看板。

zh-CN.description: 为 OpenCode Go 订阅提供配额感知的跨协议账号池化与故障转移。

zh-CN.description: 提供中文 Grok 账号管理看板，支持用量统计、Free/Super/Heavy 订阅分类、健康检查、受保护账号规则及安全凭证清理。

zh-CN.description: 将 opencode CLI 请求改写为携带 Claude Code 计费请求头与指纹，同时保留 opencode 自身的系统提示词，避免通过 CPA 代理的 Claude OAuth 订阅被识别为第三方流量。

plugins.description: Manages Codex and Antigravity credentials through quota-aware primary, regular, backup, and paused tiers with a Management Center UI.
plugins.author: William-zgx

zh-CN.description: 通过管理中心界面，按配额感知的主力、常规、备用和暂停四个层级管理 Codex 与 Antigravity 凭证。

plugins.name: Usage Query
plugins.description: Persists per-request token usage, exposes GET /v0/management/usage-stats and query/export APIs, and provides a management dashboard. Compatible with QuotaPlane and other control planes.
plugins.author: abc35277

zh-CN.description: 持久化记录单次请求 Token 用量，暴露 GET /v0/management/usage-stats 及查询/导出 API，并提供管理看板，兼容 QuotaPlane 等控制面。

plugins.name: Gemini OpenAI Normalizer
plugins.description: Normalizes Gemini OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses IDs, requested model aliases, reasoning token usage, and streaming chunks without changing non-Gemini traffic.
plugins.author: licoba

zh-CN.description: 在不影响非 Gemini 流量的前提下，规范化 Gemini 的 OpenAI Chat Completions 与 Responses 响应 ID、请求模型别名、推理 Token 用量及流式数据块。

plugins.name: Codex Message Translator
plugins.description: Transpiles Codex multi-agent agent_message payloads (encrypted_content) into plaintext input_text so DeepSeek and other openai-compatible endpoints can receive spawn/followup/send_message tasks.
plugins.author: MarioZZJ

zh-CN.description: 将 Codex 多智能体 agent_message 载荷（encrypted_content）转译为纯文本 input_text，使 DeepSeek 及其他 OpenAI 兼容端点能够接收 spawn/followup/send_message 任务。

plugins.name: Quota Pacer
plugins.description: Automatically paces Antigravity, Codex, Claude, and xAI credential priority by fresh quota evidence.
plugins.author: xg1990

zh-CN.description: 根据最新配额数据自动调节 Antigravity、Codex、Claude 与 xAI 凭证的消耗节奏与优先级。

plugins.name: CPA Key Billing
plugins.description: Adds downstream API key billing with subscription quotas, model access controls, concurrency limits, and an embedded management UI.
plugins.author: haowang02

zh-CN.description: 为下游 API Key 提供计费管理，支持订阅配额、模型访问控制、并发限制以及内嵌管理界面。

plugins.name: OpenCode Go
plugins.description: One provider for the OpenCode Go plan: chat-completions, messages, and responses routes behind one shared key pool.
plugins.author: massiveits

zh-CN.description: 面向 OpenCode Go 套餐的统一提供商插件：在共享密钥池后方同时支持 chat-completions、messages 与 responses 路由。

plugins.name: CPA Account Concurrency
plugins.description: Cache-aware, per-account hard in-flight concurrency admission for CPA Pro accounts. Prevents upstream calls above the configured account limit and returns typed local capacity errors.
plugins.author: tsunheimat

zh-CN.description: 面向 CPA Pro 账号的缓存感知型单账号硬性在途并发准入控制，防止上游调用超过配置的账号并发上限并返回类型化的本地容量错误。

plugins.name: Antigravity Proactive Refresh
plugins.description: Proactively rotates Google Antigravity OAuth access tokens and provides a management-key-protected status and refresh dashboard.
plugins.author: Senn's Team

zh-CN.description: 主动轮换刷新 Google Antigravity OAuth 访问令牌，并提供受管理密钥保护的状态与刷新看板。

plugins.name: Key Account Bind
plugins.description: Binds downstream API keys to specific upstream credentials (auth files) at scheduler.pick time. Bound pools support round-robin, weighted-round-robin, and fill-first while remaining fail-closed, without relying on frontend-auth metadata forwarding.
plugins.author: FFatTiger

zh-CN.description: 在 scheduler.pick 阶段将下游 API Key 绑定至指定的上游凭证（认证文件）；绑定池支持轮询、加权轮询与 fill-first 策略并保持故障闭合（fail-closed），无需依赖前端认证元数据透传。

plugins.name: Aggregate Usage
plugins.description: Aggregates quota and usage for one logical CPAMP account across multiple CLIProxyAPI nodes, with a management dashboard, history, and DingTalk reporting.
plugins.author: Stars4422335

zh-CN.description: 跨多个 CLIProxyAPI 节点聚合单个逻辑 CPAMP 账号的配额与用量，提供管理看板、历史记录与钉钉播报。

plugins.name: Censorship
plugins.description: Filters selected text in CLIProxyAPI request bodies with strict format and role scopes, supporting block, strip, and zero-width obfuscation modes. Use it to reject or transform configured terms before upstream execution; it never inspects or changes model responses.
plugins.author: DoingDog

zh-CN.description: 按严格的协议格式与角色范围过滤 CLIProxyAPI 请求体中的指定文本，支持阻断、剥离与零宽字符混淆模式，可在上游执行前拒绝或转换配置词条，且绝不检查或修改模型响应。

plugins.name: CommandCode Provider
plugins.description: Native commandcode.ai provider with weighted multi-key pool, per-key proxy, per-key disabled switch and failover: routes DeepSeek/GLM models through api.commandcode.ai with reasoning normalized to reasoning_content, so /v1/messages renders thinking blocks.
plugins.author: ahoo

zh-CN.description: 原生 commandcode.ai 提供商插件，支持加权多密钥池、单密钥代理、单密钥禁用开关与故障转移：通过 api.commandcode.ai 路由 DeepSeek/GLM 模型并将推理内容归一化为 reasoning_content，使 /v1/messages 正常渲染思考块。

plugins.name: CPA Bark Notifier
plugins.description: Sends opt-in Codex quota, HTTP 401/429, and recovery alerts through Bark, with selected-credential monitoring, optional scheduled quota probes, multi-device delivery, and optional encryption. Does not take over scheduling.
plugins.author: Jimu Intelligence

zh-CN.description: 通过 Bark 发送可选的 Codex 配额、HTTP 401/429 及恢复告警，支持指定凭证监控、可选定时配额探测、多设备推送与可选加密，且不接管原有调度。

plugins.name: Codex Fleet Manager
plugins.description: Manages CPA Codex accounts with quota-aware scheduling, account health monitoring, reset-window activation, and a bilingual management interface.
plugins.author: doer-ee

zh-CN.description: 通过配额感知调度、账号健康监控、重置窗口激活及中英双语管理界面管理 CPA Codex 账号集群。

plugins.name: OpenCode Session Mapper
plugins.description: Focused session-affinity interceptor for OpenCode Zen: maps Codex, Claude Code, and DeepSeek Harness conversation headers to x-opencode-session, preserves a client-supplied value, and falls back to host canonical_session_id when no source header exists. v0.3.2 adds bounded 64 MiB Host-envelope compatibility for multi-megabyte request bodies while retaining ID validation and conflict handling; it does not add quota or account-management UI.
plugins.author: ahoo

zh-CN.description: 专为 OpenCode Zen 打造的会话亲和性拦截器：将 Codex、Claude Code 与 DeepSeek Harness 的会话请求头映射为 x-opencode-session，保留客户端传入值，并在无源请求头时回退至宿主 canonical_session_id；v0.3.2 新增针对数兆字节请求体的 64 MiB 有界宿主信封兼容，同时保留 ID 校验与冲突处理（不含配额或账号管理界面）。

plugins.name: Kiro
plugins.description: A CLIProxyAPI plugin that bridges Kiro OAuth accounts to AWS CodeWhisperer and exposes a standard Claude Messages interface.
plugins.author: xiaokui-dev

zh-CN.description: 将 Kiro OAuth 账号桥接至 AWS CodeWhisperer 并暴露标准 Claude Messages 接口的 CLIProxyAPI 插件。

plugins.name: CPA Prometheus
plugins.description: Exports Prometheus metrics for CLIProxyAPI: request, token and latency counters from usage.handle, credential and auth-state gauges, and provider quota windows for Claude, Codex, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Kimi and xAI.
plugins.author: giovannirco

zh-CN.description: 为 CLIProxyAPI 导出 Prometheus 监控指标：包含来自 usage.handle 的请求、Token 与延迟计数器，凭证与认证状态仪表盘指标，以及 Claude、Codex、Antigravity、Gemini CLI、Kimi 和 xAI 的提供商配额窗口。

plugins.name: Codex Auto Ping
plugins.description: Periodically sends a minimal Codex model request through CLIProxyAPI to keep rolling usage windows active with minimal token consumption.
plugins.author: KKKKeybird

zh-CN.description: 定期通过 CLIProxyAPI 发送极简 Codex 模型请求，以最小的 Token 消耗保持滚动配额窗口处于活跃状态。

plugins.name: Kimi Tools
plugins.description: Forwards /v0/management/kimi/tools to the Kimi Datasource upstream (https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1/tools), injecting Bearer + X-Msh-* headers read fresh from a cliproxy kimi auth JSON on each request (mtime-cached). Pure plugin — no CLIProxyAPI modifications, no writes to the auth file.
plugins.author: xyonium

zh-CN.description: 将 /v0/management/kimi/tools 请求转发至 Kimi 数据源上游（https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1/tools），在每次请求时从 cliproxy kimi 认证 JSON（按 mtime 缓存）动态读取并注入 Bearer 与 X-Msh-* 请求头；纯插件实现，无需修改 CLIProxyAPI 且不改写认证文件。

plugins.name: CPA2Pool
plugins.description: Shared quota pool for CLIProxyAPI: per-participant API keys, quotas with expiry, token/image/video model pricing, consumption reporting, and an in-app feedback channel, all behind a Management Center UI.
plugins.author: LingyeNBird

zh-CN.description: 面向 CLIProxyAPI 的共享配额池：支持按参与者分配 API Key、带过期时间的配额、文本/图片/视频模型定价、消费报表及内置反馈通道，并统一集成于管理中心界面。

plugins.name: Muse Free-Tier Tools Stripper
plugins.description: Removes unsupported additional_tools entries only from Codex Responses payloads targeting OpenCode Zen Muse free-tier aliases, while leaving paid Muse and non-Codex traffic untouched.
plugins.author: ahoo

zh-CN.description: 仅从发往 OpenCode Zen Muse 免费层别名的 Codex Responses 载荷中移除不受支持的 additional_tools 条目，同时保持付费 Muse 与非 Codex 流量原样透传。

plugins.name: Smart Load Balancer
plugins.description: Load balance each client API key to its own codex profile and spends quota that resets soonest first — with per-key stickiness for better caches and reduce codex risk control. It also smart cherrypicks a request to kick off the weekly quota countdown.
plugins.author: nitansde

zh-CN.description: 将每个客户端 API Key 负载均衡到各自的 Codex profile，优先花最快到期的额度——每个 Key 固定绑定自己的 profile 以保持缓存热度、降低 Codex 风控；还会智能挑选一条真实请求来启动每周额度倒计时。

plugins.name: CommandCode GOAT/Pro/Max
plugins.description: CommandCode GOAT / Pro / Max only; does NOT support CommandCode Go (its private CLI protocol is not supported by CPA). Browser authorization and API key auth-file setup, shared host auth scheduling, multi-protocol translation through Chat Completions with reasoning preserved, and account quota.
plugins.author: mczhoucn

zh-CN.description: 仅支持 CommandCode GOAT / Pro / Max（不支持其私有 CLI 协议尚未被 CPA 兼容的 CommandCode Go）；提供浏览器授权与 API Key 认证文件配置、共享宿主认证调度、保留推理内容的多协议 Chat Completions 转换以及账号配额查询。

plugins.name: CPA Request Rewrite
plugins.description: Rewrites configured system and developer prompt text for selected upstream formats using ordered literal or regex rules with protocol-aware scopes.
plugins.author: cuteyuchen

zh-CN.description: 使用具有协议感知范围的有序字面量或正则规则，针对所选上游格式改写配置的系统提示词（system）与开发者提示词（developer）文本。

plugins.name: CPA Usage Report
plugins.description: Local-first token usage dashboard: real-time usage collection, model/key breakdown, trend chart. Bundles the cpa-usage shadcn/ui dashboard.
plugins.author: andyWang1688

zh-CN.description: 本地优先的 Token 用量看板：支持实时用量采集、按模型/Key 维度拆解与趋势图表，内置 cpa-usage shadcn/ui 仪表盘。

plugins.name: Model Sort
plugins.description: Returns the model catalog in a stable order instead of a new random order on every restart, and can pin models to the top or hide them from catalog responses using exact IDs or wildcard patterns. Hidden models stay fully routable. Covers the OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Codex client and Grok Shell listings.
plugins.author: dotiful

zh-CN.description: 以稳定顺序返回模型目录（避免每次重启后随机排序），并支持通过精确 ID 或通配符将模型置顶或从目录响应中隐藏（隐藏模型仍可正常路由），覆盖 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini、Codex 客户端及 Grok Shell 模型列表。

plugins.name: Antigravity CLI Provider
plugins.description: Adds Google Antigravity support to CLIProxyAPI via the official agy CLI, with streaming, vision, tools, and multi-turn sessions.
plugins.author: adeebahmad01

zh-CN.description: 通过官方 agy CLI 为 CLIProxyAPI 添加 Google Antigravity 支持，具备流式输出、视觉理解、工具调用及多轮会话能力。

plugins.name: Cline 渠道监控
plugins.description: Shows the Cline plan, rolling limits and official 31-day usage in the Management Center, plus the gateway channel each request actually landed on (finalProvider, read from CPA's request log), its TTFT and decode speed; with observation switched off it declares no request hook at all. A read-only configuration self-check at the top of the page lists which switches are still off, what breaks without them, and the exact line to add. An optional account guard flips a Cline account's disabled flag in CPA's own config when its real channel misses the baseline three times in a row, and re-enables it on a backoff (off by default, dry-run by default, Cline entries only).
plugins.author: wkeking

zh-CN.description: 在管理中心展示 Cline 套餐、限额与近 31 天官方用量，并按请求观测每条请求最终落在哪个网关渠道（finalProvider，取自 CPA 请求日志）、TTFT 与解码速度；观测总开关关闭时不声明任何请求钩子。页面顶部的「配置自检」按当前状态列出还差哪一项开关、缺了会少什么功能、补哪一行（只读，不替用户改配置）。可选账号守卫：某个 Cline 账号的真实渠道连续 3 次不是基准渠道时，把该账号在 CPA 配置里的 disabled 置 true，之后按退避自动放回（默认关闭、默认只试运行，只守 Cline 条目）。

plugins.name: Effort Router
plugins.description: Picks reasoning effort per user turn with a Jev-style classifier and applies it cache-safely: effort-only system messages for Claude, configuration_update items for GPT-6.
plugins.author: alex4o

zh-CN.description: 使用 Jev 风格分类器按用户轮次选择推理强度，并以缓存安全的方式应用：对 Claude 使用仅含 effort 的系统消息，对 GPT-6 使用 configuration_update 条目。

plugins.name: Mirasim Provider
plugins.description: Adds Mirasim OAuth accounts, Claude Messages and GPT Responses forwarding, dynamic models, token refresh, and quota reporting to CLIProxyAPI.
plugins.author: KIDA-MNESIA

zh-CN.description: 为 CLIProxyAPI 添加 Mirasim OAuth 账号支持、Claude Messages 与 GPT Responses 转发、动态模型发现、令牌刷新及配额报告功能。

plugins.name: ClinePassBridge
plugins.description: Seamlessly connect Cline Pass subscriptions to CPA, fetch models in one click or map them manually, avoid native non-streaming empty-response errors, and see the actual upstream provider.
plugins.author: xiao-qiu-qiu

zh-CN.description: 让 Cline Pass 订阅无缝接入 CPA，支持一键获取模型与手动映射，规避原生非流式空响应错误，轻松查看实际命中的上游。

plugins.name: Quota Reset Router
plugins.description: Routes Claude and Codex OAuth requests to the eligible account whose weekly quota resets soonest.
plugins.author: WebDevCaptain

zh-CN.description: 将 Claude 与 Codex OAuth 请求路由至每周配额最快重置的可用账号。

plugins.name: Codex App Multisession Compatibility
plugins.description: Provides opt-in replay compatibility for orphaned Codex App delegation outputs before CPA routes requests to strict upstream models.
plugins.author: patrick-fu

zh-CN.description: 在 CPA 将请求路由至严格校验的上游模型前，为孤立的 Codex App 子任务委派输出提供可选的重放兼容处理。

plugins.name: Models Cache Override
plugins.description: Overrides fields on models already present in the Codex client catalog, and can hide a model from that catalog. Untouched fields keep following CPA upstream updates. A management page can review per-model JSON from the plugin repository before applying it.
plugins.author: moxi000

zh-CN.description: 覆盖 Codex 客户端目录中已有模型的字段，并支持从目录中隐藏指定模型；未覆盖字段继续跟随 CPA 上游更新，且可通过管理页面在应用前审阅来自插件仓库的单模型 JSON 配置。

plugins.name: Codex 降智测试
plugins.description: Detects credential model degradation or model substitution in the CPA management panel through candy tests, model fingerprint probes, and ModelTrace attribution.
plugins.author: haowang02

zh-CN.description: 在 CPA 管理面板中通过糖果测试、模型指纹测试和 ModelTrace 模型归因，检测凭证是否降智或被替换模型。

plugins.name: Mirasim Proxy
plugins.description: Pure API gateway and message translator for Mirasim: provides OpenAI-compatible endpoint forwarding to Mirasim upstream relay with dynamic model catalog and OAuth authentication.
plugins.author: jellyfish-p

zh-CN.description: 面向 Mirasim 的纯 API 网关与消息转换器：提供转发至 Mirasim 上游中继的 OpenAI 兼容端点，支持动态模型目录与 OAuth 认证。

plugins.name: Codex Five-Hour Quota Warmer
plugins.description: Sends one Codex request per enabled credential at configurable daily times to warm five-hour quota windows, and includes a Management UI for editing daily schedules, running manual warm-ups, and reviewing logs.
plugins.author: Windyskr

zh-CN.description: 按可配置的每日时刻，为每个启用的 Codex 凭证各发送一次请求，提前开启五小时额度窗口；附带管理页面，可编辑每日日程、手动预热并查看运行日志。

plugins.name: Groq Whisper (cpa-groq)
plugins.description: Adds Groq Whisper speech-to-text (whisper-large-v3 and -turbo) as executor models: send audio as Gemini generateContent inline_data, get the transcript back.
plugins.author: batuhan4

zh-CN.description: 将 Groq Whisper 语音转文本模型（whisper-large-v3 与 whisper-large-v3-turbo）作为执行器模型接入：支持以 Gemini generateContent 的 inline_data 形式发送音频并返回转写文本。

plugins.name: Claude Seat Pacer
plugins.description: Paces Claude seats so each one uses up its weekly quota before the reset. New conversations go to the seat furthest behind its plan and stay there, so prompt caches keep hitting. Includes a live pace dashboard.
plugins.author: yuya-iwabuchi

zh-CN.description: 调节 Claude 席位消耗节奏，使每个席位在重置前充分利用每周配额；新会话优先分配给进度最落后的席位并保持会话粘性以提高提示词缓存命中率，附带实时配速看板。

plugins.name: Headroom Compression & Stats
plugins.description: Compresses user messages and tool outputs with Headroom and adds a standalone dashboard backed by authenticated CPA statistics APIs.
plugins.author: frankyw

zh-CN.description: 使用 Headroom 压缩用户消息与工具输出，并提供基于受认证保护的 CPA 统计 API 的独立数据看板。

plugins.name: ZCode
plugins.description: Connects BigModel Coding Plan to CPA with ZCode client fingerprint headers, dynamic model discovery, model mapping, and Anthropic-format streaming.
plugins.author: rensumo

zh-CN.description: 通过 ZCode 客户端指纹请求头、动态模型发现、模型映射与 Anthropic 格式流式输出，将智谱 BigModel Coding Plan 接入 CPA。

plugins.name: CodeBuddy Intl CPA
plugins.description: Tencent CodeBuddy OAuth provider for CLIProxyAPI, built for Global (Intl) accounts. Daily 30-credit reward via the growth centre on Global accounts, in-plugin 429/code-6004 failover, per-request credit and token log with panel, hidden upstream models (incl. live-verified gpt-6-astra), Intl realm routing, CN daily check-in, Global one-shot expert trial, credit lifecycle and a CN/Global credits panel.
plugins.author: zidanefaqih

zh-CN.description: 面向国际版（Global/Intl）账号打造的腾讯 CodeBuddy OAuth CLIProxyAPI 提供商插件：支持国际版成长中心每日 30 积分奖励、插件内 429/code-6004 故障转移、带面板的单请求积分与 Token 日志、隐藏上游模型（含实测可用的 gpt-6-astra）、国际区路由、国内版每日签到、国际版一键专家试用、积分生命周期管理及国内/国际双区积分面板。

plugins.name: CLIProxy Costs
plugins.description: Prices every request from a public rate-card feed, records usage and subscription quota in a local SQLite ledger, and adds a dashboard with spend, cache savings, quota burn-rate forecasts, failures and per-credential, per-client and per-model breakdowns. Data is served only on management routes (CPA management key).
plugins.author: MelonSmasher

zh-CN.description: 根据公开费率表为每条请求计算费用，在本地 SQLite 账本中记录用量与订阅配额，并提供涵盖支出、缓存节省、配额消耗速率预测、失败统计及按凭证/客户端/模型维度拆解的看板（数据仅通过受 CPA 管理密钥保护的管理路由提供）。

plugins.name: Claude Keep Rolling
plugins.description: Keeps Claude five-hour usage windows rolling by pinging each selected Claude account right after its window resets.

zh-CN.description: 在所选 Claude 账号的 5 小时使用窗口重置后立即发送轻量探测请求，保持 5 小时配额窗口持续滚动。

plugins.name: CPA Scheduled 5H
plugins.description: Scheduled Codex requests at each Cron minute and again one minute later, with five-hour window status, groups, pause/resume, bulk plan creation, one-click deletion of all plans while preserving CPA accounts and logs, and execution logs. Native macOS, Linux and Windows binaries.
plugins.author: gouwenct

zh-CN.description: 在每个 Cron 分钟及一分钟后定时发送 Codex 请求，支持 5 小时窗口状态查看、分组管理、暂停/恢复、批量创建计划、保留 CPA 账号与日志的一键清空计划以及执行日志记录，提供原生 macOS、Linux 与 Windows 二进制文件。

plugins.name: OpenAI OAuth Provider
plugins.description: A native Go plugin that connects CLIProxyAPI to an OAuth protected, OpenAI compatible API.
plugins.author: syepes

zh-CN.description: 将 CLIProxyAPI 连接到受 OAuth 保护的 OpenAI 兼容 API 的原生 Go 插件。

plugins.name: GitHub Copilot Provider
plugins.description: A native Go plugin that connects CLIProxyAPI to GitHub Copilot.
plugins.author: syepes

zh-CN.description: 将 CLIProxyAPI 连接到 GitHub Copilot 的原生 Go 插件。

plugins.name: Google Vextex ADC Provider
plugins.description: A native Go plugin that connects CLIProxyAPI to Google Vextex AI using ADC (Application Default Credentials).
plugins.author: syepes

zh-CN.description: 使用应用默认凭证（ADC）将 CLIProxyAPI 连接到 Google Vertex AI 的原生 Go 插件。

plugins.name: Lamplighter
plugins.description: Monitors ChatGPT, Claude and Antigravity quota with Bark or generic webhook alerts (Feishu, Telegram, etc.) and a quota chart, and starts the next 5-hour window right after each reset. Screenshots are in the repository.
plugins.author: PosvdM

plugins.name: CodexReflow

Fresh configurations automatically match standard GPT-5+ text model names, without manual lists.

plugins.name: Sticky Fill First

zh-CN.description: 粘性 Fill-First 路由策略：在故障转移接管后持续停留在当前接管凭证，而不是在高优先级账号配额重置时立即切回，从而让订阅池逐个耗尽账号配额。

plugins.author: Samuel-wyj

zh-CN.description: 按 API Key 识别并限制客户端软件（Codex CLI、Claude Code、Cursor、Cline 等）：在转发上游前读取原始请求头，支持观察/强制模式（不符合返回 403、不计费）、子串/正则/指定请求头规则、预设客户端清单，并提供按 Key 统计客户端的管理页面。
